intro.heading: Everything that happens between your application and your residence card
intro.body: The path crosses a consulate, a university, a post office, an immigration office, a tax agency, and your local municipality — none of which talk to each other. Here's the full sequence, in the order it actually happens.

routeMap.caption: All 11 steps, in the order they actually happen

disclaimer: Procedures change with annual ministerial circulars. This page reflects our current understanding of the process — always confirm time-sensitive details with the official sources linked in each step.
